title: Ragnarok thermal plant technology defaults (CCGT, OCGT, gas + H2 co-firing, BESS)

basis.priceIndexNote: EUR2015 -> EUR2025 factor from costs_2030.csv CCGT 'investment' (1108.7166 EUR/kW) over the DEA sheet 05 2030 value (830 EUR/kW); the repository applies it to every DEA 2015-price entry. Reproduces OCGT investment 435.24 -> 581.3949.

sources.dea: Danish Energy Agency technology catalogues, as redistributed in the technology-data inputs folder

h2_lhv_mj_per_nm3.source: H2 LHV 119.96 MJ/kg (US DOE Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Technologies Office, H2Tools 'Lower and Higher Heating Values of Hydrogen and Other Fuels') x normal density 0.08988 kg/Nm3 = 10.78; the task brief gives 10.8. Inputs recalled from the literature, not re-fetched in this build.

ch4_lhv_mj_per_nm3.source: CH4 LHV 50.0 MJ/kg (US DOE H2Tools table) x normal density 0.7168 kg/Nm3 = 35.8; matches the task brief. Recalled from the literature, not re-fetched in this build. Natural gas is taken as pure CH4 (a real gas of ~36-39 MJ/Nm3 shifts the vol-to-energy conversion slightly).
